name: Combination Discipline — Retain the Quick Blood

system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Celerity, Advanced Quietus. Developed during the original Anarch Revolt through an alliance between anarchs and Assamite antitribu, this exceedingly rare Discipline conserves the vitae spent fueling Celerity. Any Blood Traits spent to activate Celerity (and only Celerity) return to the character's system after one full hour, never exceeding her maximum Blood Trait pool (excess is lost). Its use is invisible to onlookers, and it does not grant unlimited vitae — hunger frenzy remains a risk when pushing one's blood limits in combat.

Costs 10 Experience Traits to learn.
system.duration: Blood Traits return after one hour
